battle_traits.name: Masters of the Wilderness
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit that has not been deployed.
battle_traits.effect: Set up that unit in reserve in ambush. It has now been deployed.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: Any number of friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS units can start the battle in reserve – even your entire Beasts of Chaos army!

battle_traits.name: Beastherd Ambush
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit that is in ambush.
battle_traits.effect:
Set up that unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for that unit.

options.name: Warping Curse
options.text: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO or, if there is a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO in reserve, within 12" of a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

options.name: Brand of Wild Fury
options.text: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit wholly within 12" of a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO or, if there is a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO in reserve, wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, roll a dice. On a 2+, the target has WARD (6+) for the rest of the turn.

options.name: Bestial Instinct
options.text: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit wholly within 12" of a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO or, if there is a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS HERO in reserve, wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge to be the target. Then, roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Arch-despoilers
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS units that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

abilities.name: Bloodgreed
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly WARHERD unit that used a FIGHT ability this turn to be the targets.

abilities.name: Fiends of the Wilds
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for a friendly BRAYHERD unit
abilities.effect: Change one of the dice in the charge roll to a 4.

abilities.name: Raging Storm
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly THUNDERSCORN unit on the battlefield to be the friendly targets, then pick each enemy unit in combat with any friendly THUNDERSCORN units to be the enemy targets.
abilities.effect: Heal (1) each friendly target. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy target, if any. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the enemy target equal to the roll.

entries.name: Death-grip
entries.timing: Reaction: Opponent declared a SHOOT ability that targeted a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit
entries.effect: If that friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS unit is not in combat and is wholly within 18" of this unit, after the SHOOT ability has been resolved, that friendly unit can move 2D6". It can move into combat.

entries.name: Bestial Cunning
entries.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS units wholly within 12" of this unit that were set up this turn using the 'Beastherd Ambush' ability to be the targets.
entries.effect: Each target can immediately move D3". The targets cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

entries.name: Propagator of Ruin
entries.effect: While this unit is on the battlefield, you can use the 'Rituals of Ruin' ability twice per turn in your hero phase instead of once per turn. You cannot pick the same effect more than once per turn.

entries.name: Slitherwrack Helm
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Gnarlstaff of Morghur
entries.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Brayblast Trumpet
entries.declare: Pick a friendly non-UNIQUE BEASTS OF CHAOS INFANTRY or CAVALRY unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Viletide
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use commands.

entries.name: Vicious Stranglethorns
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Halve the target's Move characteristic.
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

entries.name: Devolve
entries.declare: Pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy non-HERO unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• The target unit has a maximum control score of 1.
• The target cannot use commands.
• Each time the target moves, if the caster is on the battlefield, the target must end that move no further from the caster than it was at the start of the move.

entries.name: Summon Wildfire Taurus
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Wildfire Taurus on the battlefield, pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Wildfire Taurus wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Ravening Direflock
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Ravening Direflock on the battlefield, pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Ravening Direflock wholly within 18" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A Ravening Direflock has 3 parts that must each be set up within 1" of at least 1 other part.

entries.name: Summon Doomblast Dirgehorn
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Doomblast Dirgehorn on the battlefield, pick a friendly BEASTS OF CHAOS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Doomblast Dirgehorn wholly within 18" of the caster.
